sql:
SELECT
  sitename,
  general_overview ->> 'install_location'     AS install_location,
  general_overview ->> 'operating_status'     AS operating_status,
  general_overview ->> 'supply_population'    AS supply_population,
  service_area,
  general_overview -> 'reservoir_spec' ->> 'facility_capacity_m3' AS facility_capacity,
  general_overview -> 'reservoir_spec' ->> 'count' AS reservoir_count,
  general_overview -> 'reservoir_spec' ->> 'H.W.L' AS hwl,
  general_overview -> 'reservoir_spec' ->> 'L.W.L' AS lwl,
  CASE
    WHEN general_overview ? 'emergency_water_plan'
     AND jsonb_typeof(general_overview -> 'emergency_water_plan') = 'array'
     AND jsonb_array_length(general_overview -> 'emergency_water_plan') > 0
    THEN
      '비상 용수 공급 방안은 '
      || (
        SELECT string_agg(value, ', ')
        FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
          general_overview -> 'emergency_water_plan'
        )
      )
      || ' 입니다.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS emergency_water_plan_sentence,
  CASE
    WHEN general_overview ? 'water_truck_accessible'
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN general_overview ->> 'water_truck_accessible' = 'true'
        THEN '비상 시 물차 진입이 가능합니다.'
        ELSE '비상 시 물차 진입이 불가능합니다.'
      END
    ELSE NULL
  END AS water_truck_accessible_sentence,
  CASE
    WHEN general_overview ? 'water_truck_turning_possible'
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN general_overview ->> 'water_truck_turning_possible' = 'true'
        THEN '물차 회차가 가능합니다.'
        ELSE '물차 회차가 불가능합니다.'
      END
    ELSE NULL
  END AS water_truck_turning_possible_sentence,
  CASE WHEN general_overview ->> 'water_truck_accessible' = 'true' THEN '가능' ELSE '불가능' END AS water_truck_access_label,
  CASE WHEN general_overview ->> 'water_truck_accessible' = 'true' THEN 'OK' ELSE 'NO' END AS water_truck_access_pill,
  CASE WHEN general_overview ->> 'water_truck_accessible' = 'true' THEN 'ok' ELSE 'critical' END AS water_truck_access_tone,
  CASE WHEN general_overview ->> 'water_truck_turning_possible' = 'true' THEN '가능' ELSE '불가능' END AS water_truck_turn_label,
  CASE WHEN general_overview ->> 'water_truck_turning_possible' = 'true' THEN 'OK' ELSE 'NO' END AS water_truck_turn_pill,
  CASE WHEN general_overview ->> 'water_truck_turning_possible' = 'true' THEN 'ok' ELSE 'critical' END AS water_truck_turn_tone,
  total_supply_time
FROM v_reservoir_info_status
WHERE sitename = '{sitename}';

sql:
WITH current_pressure AS (
    SELECT 
        i.sitename,
        i.facilitytype,
        i.datainfo,
        i.unit,
        r.val AS pressure_val,
        r.logtime
    FROM tb_tag_info i
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT val, logtime
        FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
        WHERE r.tagsn = i.tagsn
        ORDER BY r.logtime DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) r ON TRUE
    WHERE i.sitename = '{sitename}'
      AND i.facilitytype = '{facilitytype}'
      AND i.tagtype = 'Analog Input'
      AND i.datainfo ILIKE '%압력%'
),
avg_pressure AS (
    SELECT
        sitename,
        facilitytype,
        datainfo,
        month_avg,
        year_avg,
        unit
    FROM fn_pressure_avg_summary('{sitename}', '{facilitytype}')
)
SELECT
    c.sitename,
    c.facilitytype,
    c.datainfo,
    c.pressure_val,
    to_char(c.logtime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS log_time,
    a.month_avg,
    a.year_avg,
    c.unit
FROM current_pressure c
LEFT JOIN avg_pressure a
  ON c.sitename      = a.sitename
 AND c.facilitytype = a.facilitytype
 AND c.datainfo     = a.datainfo
ORDER BY c.datainfo;

WITH current_nmf AS (
    SELECT
        log_time,
        sitename,
        facilitytype,
        label,
        datadesc,
        unit,
        val AS current_val
    FROM fn_night_min_flow_summary(
            '{sitename}',
            '{facilitytype}',
            (now() - interval '1 day')::date,
            now()::date
    )
    ORDER BY log_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_nmf AS (
    SELECT
        sitename,
        facilitytype,
        label,
        datadesc,
        unit,
        period_type,
        ROUND(AVG(val), 2) AS avg_val
    FROM (
        SELECT sitename, facilitytype, label, datadesc, unit, val, 'year' AS period_type
        FROM fn_night_min_flow_summary('{sitename}', '{facilitytype}', (now() - interval '1 year')::date, now()::date)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT sitename, facilitytype, label, datadesc, unit, val, 'month' AS period_type
        FROM fn_night_min_flow_summary('{sitename}', '{facilitytype}', (now() - interval '1 month')::date, now()::date)
    ) t
    GROUP BY sitename, facilitytype, label, datadesc, unit, period_type
)
SELECT
    c.sitename,
    c.facilitytype,
    c.label,
    c.datadesc,
    c.current_val,
    c.unit,
    c.log_time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.period_type = 'month' THEN a.avg_val END) AS avg_month,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.period_type = 'year'  THEN a.avg_val END) AS avg_year
FROM current_nmf c
LEFT JOIN avg_nmf a
  ON c.sitename = a.sitename
 AND c.facilitytype = a.facilitytype
 AND c.label = a.label
 AND c.datadesc = a.datadesc
GROUP BY c.sitename, c.facilitytype, c.label, c.datadesc, c.current_val, c.unit, c.log_time;

SELECT
  alarm_msg,
  SUM(cause_count) AS alarm_count,
  COALESCE(string_agg(
    CASE WHEN diagnosed_cause IS NOT NULL AND diagnosed_cause <> ''
         THEN diagnosed_cause || ' (' || cause_count || '건)' END,
    '; ' ORDER BY cause_count DESC, diagnosed_cause
  ), '') AS diagnosed_causes
FROM (
  SELECT alarm_msg, diagnosed_cause, COUNT(*) AS cause_count
  FROM tb_equipment_alarm_report
  WHERE alarm_start_time >= {from_ts}
    AND alarm_start_time < {to_ts}::date + 1
    AND ('{sitename}' = '' OR sitename = '{sitename}')
    AND ('{facilitytype}' = '' OR facilitytype = '{facilitytype}')
    {alarm_filter_clause}
  GROUP BY alarm_msg, diagnosed_cause
) t
GROUP BY alarm_msg
ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
LIMIT {limit};

SELECT
  alarm_msg,
  SUM(cause_count) AS alarm_count,
  COALESCE(string_agg(
    CASE WHEN diagnosed_cause IS NOT NULL AND diagnosed_cause <> ''
         THEN diagnosed_cause || ' (' || cause_count || '건)' END,
    '; ' ORDER BY cause_count DESC, diagnosed_cause
  ), '') AS diagnosed_causes
FROM (
  SELECT alarm_msg, diagnosed_cause, COUNT(*) AS cause_count
  FROM tb_equipment_alarm_report
  WHERE ('{sitename}' = '' OR sitename = '{sitename}')
    AND ('{facilitytype}' = '' OR facilitytype = '{facilitytype}')
    {alarm_filter_clause}
  GROUP BY alarm_msg, diagnosed_cause
) t
GROUP BY alarm_msg
ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
LIMIT {limit};

questions: 지금 이 시간 신평 배수지 수위를 알려줘
sql:
SELECT
  i.sitename,
  i.facilitytype,
  i.datainfo,
  i.datadesc,
  l.tagsn,
  l.val AS latest_val,
  to_char(l.logtime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS latest_time
FROM tb_tag_info i
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT r.tagsn, r.val, r.logtime
  FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
  WHERE r.tagsn = i.tagsn
  ORDER BY r.logtime DESC
  LIMIT 1
) l ON TRUE
WHERE i.sitename = '{sitename}'
  AND i.facilitytype = '{facilitytype}'
  AND (
        i.datadesc ILIKE '%{datakey}%'
     OR i.datainfo ILIKE '%{datakey}%'
  )
ORDER BY l.tagsn;

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT result_facilitytype, result_sitename, result_missing_pct
    FROM public.fn_realtime_missing_summary('{sitename}', '{facilitytype}', '{datainfo}')
)
SELECT result_facilitytype AS facilitytype,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN result_missing_pct > 50 THEN 1 END) AS missing_cnt,
       STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN result_missing_pct > 50 THEN result_sitename END, ', ' ORDER BY result_sitename) AS missing_sites
FROM base
GROUP BY result_facilitytype
ORDER BY result_facilitytype;

sql:
SELECT
    m.sitename,
    m.facilitytype,
    fn_night_min_flow_stats('{sitename}', '{facilitytype}') AS stats_report,
    m.avg_val AS avg_month,
    y.avg_val AS avg_year,
    m.unit
FROM (
    SELECT 
        sitename,
        facilitytype,
        ROUND(AVG(val), 2) AS avg_val,
        '㎥/hr' AS unit
    FROM fn_night_min_flow_summary(
        '{sitename}',
        '{facilitytype}',
        date_trunc('month', now())::date,
        now()::date
    )
    GROUP BY sitename, facilitytype
) m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sitename,
        facilitytype,
        ROUND(AVG(val), 2) AS avg_val
    FROM fn_night_min_flow_summary(
        '{sitename}',
        '{facilitytype}',
        date_trunc('year', now())::date,
        now()::date
    )
    GROUP BY sitename, facilitytype
) y
  ON m.sitename = y.sitename
 AND m.facilitytype = y.facilitytype;

items.text: Z-Score는 동일 요일·시간대 기준 평균 대비 현재 값의 통계적 이탈 정도입니다. (평일/주말 × 피크/오프피크 4구간 분리)
"평소 대비 ±N%"는 동일 요일·시간대 평균 대비 현재 값의 변동 비율입니다.
간헐 가동 장비는 가동 중 데이터만으로 평균을 산출합니다. (가동률 표시)
통신장애는 해당 사이트의 통신이상 태그(10분 내)를 기준으로 판정합니다.
Isolation Forest는 다변량 ML 모델로, Z-Score와 독립적으로 이상을 판정합니다. 양쪽 모두 이상으로 판정한 건(동의)이 신뢰도가 높습니다.

questions: 기지시 가압장 이상 여부를 정밀 진단해줘
sql:
WITH facility_arr AS (
    SELECT array_agg(tagsn) AS arr
    FROM tb_tag_info
    WHERE sitename = '{sitename}'
        AND facilitytype = '{facilitytype}'
        AND tagtype = 'Analog Input'
        AND datainfo NOT LIKE '%적산%' AND datainfo NOT LIKE '%설정%'
),
raw_adaptive AS (
    SELECT c.tagsn, c.bucket,
        (c.min_val + c.max_val) / 2.0 AS approx_avg,
        CASE WHEN c.min_val = c.max_val THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_flat,
        date_trunc('hour', c.bucket) AS bucket_hr,
        CASE WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM c.bucket) IN (6, 7) THEN 'WE' ELSE 'WD' END AS day_type,
        CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM c.bucket) BETWEEN 6 AND 21 THEN 'PK' ELSE 'OP' END AS time_slot
    FROM cagg_5min_raw_stats_ai c, facility_arr fa
    WHERE c.tagsn = ANY(fa.arr)
        AND c.bucket >= now() - interval '365 days'
),
time_ctx AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM now()) IN (6, 7) THEN 'WE' ELSE 'WD' END AS cur_day,
        CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM now()) BETWEEN 6 AND 21 THEN 'PK' ELSE 'OP' END AS cur_slot
),
hourly_holding AS (
    SELECT tagsn, bucket_hr
    FROM raw_adaptive
    WHERE approx_avg > 0.001
    GROUP BY tagsn, bucket_hr
    HAVING SUM(is_flat) = COUNT(*)
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT ROUND(approx_avg::numeric, 1)) <= 1
       AND COUNT(*) >= 6
),
stats_segment AS (
    SELECT r.tagsn,
        AVG(r.approx_avg) FILTER (WHERE r.approx_avg > 0.001) AS mean_seg,
        STDDEV_POP(r.approx_avg) FILTER (WHERE r.approx_avg > 0.001) AS stddev_seg,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.approx_avg > 0.001) AS seg_cnt
    FROM raw_adaptive r
    CROSS JOIN time_ctx tc
    LEFT JOIN hourly_holding hh ON r.tagsn = hh.tagsn AND r.bucket_hr = hh.bucket_hr
    WHERE r.day_type = tc.cur_day AND r.time_slot = tc.cur_slot
        AND hh.bucket_hr IS NULL
    GROUP BY r.tagsn
),
stats_global AS (
    SELECT r.tagsn,
        AVG(r.approx_avg) FILTER (WHERE r.approx_avg > 0.001) AS mean_all,
        STDDEV_POP(r.approx_avg) FILTER (WHERE r.approx_avg > 0.001) AS stddev_all,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.approx_avg > 0.001) AS active_cnt,
        COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
    FROM raw_adaptive r
    LEFT JOIN hourly_holding hh ON r.tagsn = hh.tagsn AND r.bucket_hr = hh.bucket_hr
    WHERE hh.bucket_hr IS NULL
    GROUP BY r.tagsn
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.approx_avg > 0.001) >= 50
),
stats_30d AS (
    SELECT g.tagsn,
        COALESCE(CASE WHEN s.seg_cnt >= 30 THEN s.mean_seg END, g.mean_all) AS mean_30d,
        COALESCE(CASE WHEN s.seg_cnt >= 30 THEN s.stddev_seg END, g.stddev_all) AS stddev_30d,
        g.active_cnt,
        g.total_cnt
    FROM stats_global g
    LEFT JOIN stats_segment s ON g.tagsn = s.tagsn
),
lmax AS (
    SELECT c.tagsn, MAX(c.bucket) AS mt
    FROM cagg_5min_raw_stats_ai c, facility_arr fa
    WHERE c.tagsn = ANY(fa.arr)
        AND c.bucket >= now() - interval '3 hours'
    GROUP BY c.tagsn
),
latest AS (
    SELECT c.tagsn,
        (c.min_val + c.max_val) / 2.0 AS current_val,
        c.bucket AS latest_time
    FROM cagg_5min_raw_stats_ai c
    JOIN lmax ON c.tagsn = lmax.tagsn AND c.bucket = lmax.mt
),
raw_recent AS (
    SELECT r.tagsn, r.logtime, r.val,
        LAG(r.val) OVER (PARTITION BY r.tagsn ORDER BY r.logtime) AS prev_val
    FROM tb_tag_raw_data r, facility_arr fa
    WHERE r.tagsn = ANY(fa.arr)
        AND r.logtime >= now() - interval '5 minutes'
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT tagsn, logtime, val, prev_val,
        val - prev_val AS diff,
        LAG(val - prev_val) OVER (PARTITION BY tagsn ORDER BY logtime) AS prev_diff
    FROM raw_recent WHERE prev_val IS NOT NULL
),
dir_changes AS (
    SELECT tagsn,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE
            ABS(diff) > 0.001 AND ABS(prev_diff) > 0.001
            AND SIGN(diff) != SIGN(prev_diff)
        ) AS change_count
    FROM with_diff WHERE prev_diff IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY tagsn
)
SELECT
    ti.tagsn,
    ti.sitename,
    ti.facilitytype,
    ti.datainfo,
    ROUND(l.current_val::numeric, 2) AS current_val,
    ROUND(s.mean_30d::numeric, 2) AS mean_30d,
    CASE
        WHEN ABS(l.current_val) < 0.001 THEN 0
        WHEN s.stddev_30d > 0.001
            THEN ROUND(((l.current_val - s.mean_30d) / s.stddev_30d)::numeric, 2)
        ELSE 0
    END AS z_score,
    CASE
        WHEN ABS(l.current_val) < 0.001 THEN 0
        WHEN ABS(s.mean_30d) < 0.001 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND((ABS(l.current_val - s.mean_30d) / ABS(s.mean_30d) * 100)::numeric, 1)
    END AS deviation_pct,
    COALESCE(dc.change_count, 0) AS change_count,
    ROUND(s.active_cnt::numeric * 100 / NULLIF(s.total_cnt, 0), 0) AS active_pct,
    l.latest_time
FROM latest l
JOIN stats_30d s ON l.tagsn = s.tagsn
JOIN tb_tag_info ti ON l.tagsn = ti.tagsn
LEFT JOIN dir_changes dc ON l.tagsn = dc.tagsn
ORDER BY ABS(CASE
    WHEN ABS(l.current_val) < 0.001 THEN 0
    WHEN s.stddev_30d > 0.001
        THEN (l.current_val - s.mean_30d) / s.stddev_30d
    ELSE 0 END) DESC

items.text: 값 분석(Z-Score): 동일 요일·시간대 기준선 대비 현재 값의 이탈 정도 판정
패턴 분석(진동): 최근 5분간 값의 방향 전환 횟수로 채터링 판정
복합 판정: 값정상+패턴정상=정상, 값이상+패턴정상=값이상, 값정상+패턴이상=패턴이상, 양쪽이상=심각
간헐 가동 장비는 가동 중 데이터만으로 평균을 산출합니다.
Isolation Forest: 다변량 ML 모델로 센서 간 상관관계를 고려한 이상 판정. Z-Score와 독립 분석 후 결과를 종합합니다.
최근 7일간 발생한 알람을 시간 역순으로 최대 100건 표시합니다.
경보 발생 누적건수가 높은 순서대로 보여줘

sql: JOIN tb_tag_info ti ON c.tagsn = ti.tagsn
regr_slope(approx_avg, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM bucket)) AS slope,
regr_intercept(approx_avg, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM bucket)) AS intercept,
regr_r2(approx_avg, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM bucket)) AS r_squared,
AVG((min_val + max_val) / 2.0) FILTER (WHERE (min_val + max_val) / 2.0 > 0.001) AS mean_30d,
STDDEV_POP((min_val + max_val) / 2.0) FILTER (WHERE (min_val + max_val) / 2.0 > 0.001) AS stddev_30d
ROUND((r.slope * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() + interval '1 hour') + r.intercept)::numeric, 2) AS predicted_1h,
JOIN baseline_30d b ON p.tagsn = b.tagsn
JOIN tb_tag_info ti ON p.tagsn = ti.tagsn
ORDER BY ABS((p.predicted_1h - b.mean_30d) / b.stddev_30d) DESC

items.text: CUSUM(누적합)은 야간최소유량의 미세한 증가 추세를 누적하여 감지합니다.
기준선(μ) 대비 허용치(k=0.5σ)를 초과하는 편차가 누적되면 누수 의심 신호입니다.
임계값(h=4σ) 초과 시 '누수 의심', 3σ 초과 시 '주의'로 판정합니다.
